predictions.schema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS predictions (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, input TEXT NOT NULL, completion TEXT NOT NULL, hits INTEGER DEFAULT 1, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

threads.schema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS threads (  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, start_time TIMESTAMP, end_time TIMESTAMP, cause TEXT, topic TEXT, content TEXT, is_processed BOOLEAN, speakers_id INTEGER, speaker_id_method INTEGER)

msgs.schema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS msgs (  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,  thread_id INTEGER, author TEXT NOT NULL, datetime TIMESTAMP, msg TEXT, answers TEXT, msg_input TEXT, FOREIGN KEY (thread_id) REFERENCES conversation_threads(id))

documents.schema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS documents (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT, filename TEXT NOT NULL, always_send INTEGER DEFAULT 0, created_at TIMESTAMP)

chunks.schema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chunks (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, docstore_id TEXT, type INTEGER, content TEXT, reason TEXT, theme TEXT, tags TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP, document_id INTEGER, conversation_id INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES documents(id), FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversation_threads(id))

records.schema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS records (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, plugin TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, filename TEXT NOT NULL)

usage.schema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS usage (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, msg TEXT NOT NULL, datetime TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, onboarding INTEGER NOT NULL, bid INTEGER NOT NULL)

speakers.schema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS speakers (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, freq INTEGER DEFAULT 0)

records.schema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS records (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, recorder_id INTEGER NOT NULL, speakers_id INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (recorder_id) REFERENCES recorder_records(id), FOREIGN KEY (speakers_id) REFERENCES speakers(id))

__note__: Snapshot of db_tables as last RELEASED. Refresh discipline: before changing any plugin schema, copy the current plugin.json db_tables here (docs/updates.md release checklist). tools/test_migrations.py builds old databases from this snapshot and runs the current repo schemas against them.
